artifacts.summary: Implementation plan with 4 phases for proving Bimodal TM conservative over Temporal BX using semantic bridge approach

memory_candidates.content: Domain mismatch pattern in conservative extension proofs: bimodal soundness requires AddCommGroup D while temporal completeness quantifies over arbitrary LinearOrder D. The temporal completeness proof constructs its countermodel on ChronicleSubtype (subtype of Q), which inherits LinearOrder but not AddCommGroup. Resolution requires either: (a) extending temporal models from the countermodel domain to Q (which has AddCommGroup), (b) proving a validity transfer lemma, or (c) using a syntactic approach. The semantic bridge between truthAt and Satisfies is straightforward for temporal (box-free) formulas via structural induction. The atom case requires a non-trivial task frame with WorldState = D (not Unit) so that the world history states function maps time points to themselves, making valuation time-dependent.
